page.overview:
Who is Big Eatie's Mate?

Little Eatie (daughter)|born=Before 2015|appearances=Jurassic World: Camp Cretaceous (mentioned)|role=|died=}}

Big Eatie's mate was a Tyrannosaurus rex that lived on Isla Sorna with his mate Big Eatie and his daughter Little Eatie. In Jurassic World: Camp Cretaceous, Dr. Mae Turner states that Mantah Corp took some dinosaurs from Isla Sorna to Mantah Corp Island. Big Eatie and Little Eatie were transported but it is unknown what happened to this individual. It could be possible that he died after Little Eatie was born, or was left behind by Mantah Corp.
